mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fin_open_item WHERE ORDER BY COALESCE(basis_date,biz_date) DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gross_amount),0) gross_amount,COALESCE(SUM(settled_amount),0) settled_amount, COALESCE(SUM(gross_amount-settled_amount),0) outstanding_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN gross_amount-settled_amount ELSE 0 END),0) overdue_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount-allocated_amount),0) FROM fin_payment WHERE direction=#{q.direction} AND status!='VOID' AND partner_id=#{q.partnerId} AND DATE_FORMAT(payment_date,'%Y-%m')=#{q.period}) unallocated_amount FROM fin_open_item WHERE
SELECT * FROM fin_open_item WHERE source_type=#{type} AND source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY id

SELECT * FROM fin_open_item WHERE direction=#{direction} AND partner_id=#{partnerId} AND statement_id IS NULL AND reconcile_status='OPEN' ORDER BY basis_date,id

mapper.update: UPDATE fin_open_item SET reconcile_status=#{status}, statement_id=#{statementId} WHERE id=#{id} AND reconcile_status=#{expected}
UPDATE fin_open_item SET due_date=#{dueDate} WHERE id=#{id} AND statement_id IS NULL
